info.name: Tandil Backend - Flow-Based Collection
info.description:
Tandil Backend API. All responses JSON. Set env: base_url, token. Use Bearer token for protected routes. Technician and Supervisor leave-request submit: use form-data (leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason).

**Technician → Supervisor report:** Technician sends report with POST /api/technician/report/{{visit_id}} (visit_id in URL; form-data: technician_notes, before_photo, after_photo). Supervisor sees reports with GET /api/supervisor/reports. Set {{visit_id}} to the job id when testing.

Admin Zones & Teams: Areas (zones) list/create/get/update/delete with supervisor name and location; All Technicians (with search); All Supervisors (with search); Supervisor Team get/add/remove member. See folder **17 → H. Admin - Areas (Zones)**.

**Client shop & orders:** folder **8. Client Dashboard – Shop & Orders** uses subfolders **A→K** (A–J as before, **K** = Coupons validate/checkout, **I** = Stripe / PayPal / React Native PaymentIntent + webhooks). **Hosted Checkout + PayPal + RN** requests live under folder **8** → **I. Shop – Payments**. Organized by dashboard: ADMIN (Stats, Users & HR, Support Tickets, Reports, Settings) · CLIENT · TECHNICIAN (folder 9) · SUPERVISOR (folder 10). Support ticket (chat) APIs per role: Client = Module 3 (Help and Support 10–14). Technician = Module 9 (Support help center, FAQs, submit, list my tickets, get by ID, reply). Supervisor = Module 10 (F. Support Tickets). Area Manager / HR = same /api/support/* with their token – see Module 15 'Support Tickets – All roles'. Admin = Module 13 (list/respond to all tickets). Admin profile update: form-data only, no current_password; use password + password_confirmation to change password.

**Area Manager:** Dashboard (summary, alerts, region-map), Teams (list → detail → members → member jobs). Use {{team_id}} from Teams list for GET /teams/{{team_id}}, /teams/{{team_id}}/members, and for Member Jobs add ?team_id={{team_id}} so job counts match members. Analytics: GET /api/area-manager/analytics?period=today|week|month.

**Postman 3.3.6:** Admin **GET /api/admin/notifications/delivery-stats** (by_audience + by_audience_labeled + by_notification_type); broadcast send/list/detail; /api/user/notifications and /api/client/notifications document per_page, optional audience_role; clear-all deletes with deleted_count.

**Notifications hub:** Folder **Notifications - All roles (hub)** lists every notification API by role (Shared, User profile, Client, Technician, Supervisor, Area Manager, HR, Admin). **17. Other Modules** uses subfolders **A→O** (Support, Offers, Complaints, Tips, Admin catalog, User profile, etc.).

**Coupons:** **5f** admin CRUD · **8 → K** client: `GET browse?category_id|service_id` (promos on catalog) · `POST checkout-offers` (choose promo modal) · `POST apply` (**body: `code` only** — % or fixed discount → `order_summary` + optional `payment_intent_id`) · `POST validate` · payment-intent with `coupon_code`. Spec: `docs/COUPON_API.md`.

**Maintenance Photos:** Admin **5g** — `GET list` → `GET /api/admin/maintenance-photos/{id}` (**edit screen detail**) → create/update/delete. Body fields only: title, before_image, after_image, priority, active. Image URLs: `/media/maintenance_photos/...` (not `/storage/`). Client **8b** — `GET /api/maintenance-photos` read-only (active, by priority).

**Vendor marketplace:** folder **2** + **18**. **M** Compare vendors (`compare_vendors.available` on product detail; same **product name** + category; `GET /compare-vendors`) · **P** Vendor Store (`GET /api/shop/vendors/{id}` — vendor + products in one response). Demo seed: `php artisan vendor:compare-demo-seed`. Auth: `{{vendor_token}}` for vendor portal only.

request.description:
Update subscription details

**Uses POST, not PUT.** PHP does not parse request fields for PUT requests with a multipart/form-data body (only POST), so a real PUT here would silently do nothing while still returning a 200 success. The backend route accepts both PUT and POST for this endpoint — use POST here because this request uploads a `picture` file.

**Updatable Fields (Admin Only):** `plan`, `plan_name`, `subtitle`, `description`, `target_type`, `picture`, `amount`, `payment_status`, `payment_reference`, `completed_visits`, `features`

**Updatable Fields (Admin or Owner):** `start_date`, `end_date`, `picture`, `description`

**Note:** Only admins can update pricing/status/plan fields. Regular users (subscription owners) can only update `start_date`, `end_date`, `picture`, and `description` for their own subscriptions. `client_id`/`client_ids` cannot be changed after creation — cancel and recreate the subscription under a different client instead.

Mark subscription as paid

**Purpose:**
- Updates subscription payment_status to 'paid'
- Sends notification to client about payment confirmation
- Can be used by admin or subscription owner

**Use Cases:**
- After payment gateway webhook confirmation
- Manual payment confirmation by admin
- Client confirming their own payment

Cancel/delete subscription

**Purpose:**
- Permanently deletes a subscription
- Can be used by admin or subscription owner

**Use Cases:**
- Client cancelling their subscription
- Admin removing invalid subscriptions
- Refund processing

**Purpose:**
- Returns comprehensive statistics for total users, active subscriptions, monthly revenue, customers, technicians, and employees
- Includes counts/amounts for daily, weekly, monthly, yearly periods
- Provides growth percentages vs previous periods with automatic + and - signs
- Used by admin mobile app dashboard

- `total_users`: All users regardless of role (total, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly + growth)
- `active_subscriptions`: Paid subscriptions that haven't expired (total, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly + growth)

**Purpose:**

- Includes percentage growth vs previous period (yesterday)
- Used to display "Quick Overview" cards in admin mobile app

**Response Structure:**
- `pending_reports`: Count of reports with status 'pending' + growth percentage
- `new_orders`: Count of orders created today + growth percentage

- `new_customers`: Count of customers registered today + growth percentage
- `new_subscriptions`: Count of paid subscriptions created today + growth percentage
- `revenue_today`: Total revenue from paid orders today + growth percentage
- `pending_visits`: Count of scheduled but not completed visits + growth percentage

- Growth values are strings with automatic + or - sign (e.g., "+12", "-5")
- Positive growth: Includes '+' sign (e.g., "+12", "+8")
- Negative growth: Includes '-' sign (e.g., "-5", "-10")

- Represents percentage change vs previous period (yesterday)
